# Only add an advisory with no usable fix. An exemption past its review-by

GO-2026-6665 2026-12-01 gosnowflake writes sensitive information to logs; no fixed v1 release (v1.19.1 is latest). Track a patched v1 or migration to gosnowflake/v2, and keep Snowflake driver logging at its default level.
